newsitem.title: USA: At Home launches broadband audio service.
newsitem.headline: At Home launches broadband audio service.

text.p: At Home Corp, the high-speed Internet access company, said on Friday it has launched a 24-hour broadband audio feature on its network so that customers can download music.
The new feature uses Progressive Network's RealAudio streaming technology to deliver audio directly to desktops at 80 kilobits per second (kbps), compared with the 28.8 kbps commonly available.
At Home subscribers can use the beta release of the "TuneIn" feature, choosing from eight different music channels, the company said in a press release.

Eventually, the company said it plans to offer live music events, technology and sports news through partnerships with N2K's Music Boulevard, CNET Inc's CNET Radio, and Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS SportsLine.
